title: Insertion Sort List
summary: Given the head of a singly linked list, apply the insertion sort algorithm to sort the list, and return the head of the sorted list.
statement: Given the head of a singly linked list, apply the insertion sort algorithm to sort the list, and return the head of the sorted list. The algorithm iterates through the list, removing one element at a time, finding its correct position in the sorted portion of the list, and inserting it there. This process continues until all elements are in sorted order.
constraints: The linked list may be empty and contains integer values.
Sort nodes in nondecreasing order with insertion-sort logic.
reference_solution:
def insertion_sort_linked_list(head):
    dummy=ListNode(float('-inf'));current=head
    while current:
        following=current.next;place=dummy
        while place.next and place.next.val<=current.val:place=place.next
        current.next=place.next;place.next=current;current=following
    return dummy.next

def insertion_sort_linked_list(head):
    dummy=ListNode(float('-inf'));current=head
    while current:
        following=current.next.next if current.next else None;place=dummy
        while place.next and place.next.val<=current.val:place=place.next
        current.next=place.next;place.next=current;current=following
